text: This report recommends that the name “Dream Lane” be approved to identify an existing public lane located north of St. Clair Avenue West, extending between Raglan Avenue and Vaughan Road. This naming proposal complies with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy which can be found at https://www.toronto.ca/city-government/planning-development/street-naming/
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rejected the name "Dream Lane" for an existing public lane located north of St. Clair Avenue West, extending between Raglan Avenue and Vaughan Road.
